chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who has slaves and then wills the freeing of one-third of them. He said: "ʿAlī عليه السلام used to draw lots among them."

key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكُونَ: owned slaves or bondservants under a person's possession
key_terms.فَيُوصِي: he makes a bequest or will
key_terms.يُسْهِمُ: he would draw lots or apportion by lot

ai.seo_question: How is it decided which slaves are freed if a man wills the emancipation of one-third of them?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling concerning a man who wills the emancipation of one-third of his owned slaves. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام reports that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام would determine which of them were freed by drawing lots among them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3396 - Hariz narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

"I asked Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a man who has slaves and wills to free one-third of them.
Imam (as) said: 'Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) used to draw lots among them.'"
